records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過統一的 GPU 與 CUDA 軟體堆疊，以相同的底層硬體架構同時服務資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場，僅透過不同的軟體堆疊與應用框架來滿足各領域需求【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。該公司指出，其平台針對資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與汽車四大市場，並採用統一的底層架構（GPU、互連與軟體堆疊）來滿足這些多樣化的運算需求【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。由於架構的可程式化特性，NVIDIA 能夠利用相同的 GPU 核心，透過內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊、SDK、API 與領域特定應用框架，支援多個價值數十億美元的終端市場【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19】。具體而言，NVIDIA 提供 CUDA 平行程式設計模型、數百種領域特定的加速函式庫、軟體開發套件（SDK）與應用程式介面（API），這些構成了深廣的軟體堆疊，使得相同硬體能夠加速 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算、3D 圖形以及機器人與數位雙胞胎等工作負載【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19】。在資料中心側，NVIDIA 將 GPU、CPU、DPU、互連與網路交換器等硬體整合為超級電腦平台與伺服器，並搭配 NVIDIA AI Enterprise、DGX Cloud 等軟體與服務；在遊戲側則提供 GeForce GPU 與 GeForce NOW 串流服務；專業視覺化則提供 Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPU 與 vGPU 軟體；車用則提供汽車平台、自駕與電動車解決方案以及 Omniverse Enterprise 軟體【NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 作為 AI 功能內建到 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等產品中，並將其作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 與 Consumer 訂閱方案的核心附加值，來提升每位使用者的收入並推動座位成長。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  

根據 2025 年度 10-K 說明，Microsoft 365 Commercial 是一個 AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台，整合了 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security，旨在幫助組織賦能員工。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  
該段落指出，成長取決於在新市場（如前線工作者、中小企業及成長市場）開發新使用者，以及在核心產品與服務中加入 AI 工具、功能及代理情境，涵蓋溝通、協作、分析、安全、合規及其他 AI 商業生產力類別。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  

在 2026 年 3 月結束的季度中，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入成長 19%，收入 per user 的增長受到 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的帶動。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]

營業費用增加 7.95 億美元（或 11%），主要來自於研發運算容量、AI 人才與資料的投資，以支援整個產品組合的開發，以及較高的 Copilot 廣告費用。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]

Microsoft 365 Consumer 雲端收入與 Office Consumer 產品收入主要受客戶在新設備上購買 Office 的比例以及從傳統 Office 永久授權轉向 Microsoft 365 Consumer 訂閱的影響。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  
該收入也受到透過 Outlook.com 與 OneDrive 進行通訊與儲存需求的影響，這主要由訂閱與廣告帶動。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Windows Commercial 與 Microsoft 365 雲端服務及 Copilot 整合，讓 Windows 使用者自然轉向訂閱雲端與 AI 功能，從而帶動參與度提升。  

- 在 FY2025 全 fiscal year，Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品收入因 Windows Commercial on‑premises 元件與 Office 2024 交易購買增長而成長 **7%**，這顯示 Windows 帶動了商業產品的採用[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。  
- 在 2025 年 9 月 30 日止的三個月（Q1 FY2026），同一項產品收入因 Office 2024 交易購買以及 Windows Commercial on‑premises 元件增長而成長 **17%**，進一步顯示 Windows 在近期對商業產品的拉動效應更強[MSFT_10Q_202509.html, chunk #66]。  
- 同期，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入在 FY2025 成長 **15%**，主要受商業座位成長（6%）及每用戶收入提升推動[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。  
- 在 2025 年 9 月 30 日止的三個月，雲端收入成長 **17%**，且每用戶收入的增長受 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Copilot 推動，同時受期間內收入確認的利益影響[MSFT_10Q_202509.html, chunk #66]。  

這些數據表明，Windows Commercial 的使用與升級不僅直接帶動了 Microsoft 365 商業產品的銷售，也透過提升每用戶收入及促進 Copilot、E5 等雲端與 AI 服務的採用，間接提升了雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度。[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #134][MSFT_10Q_202509.html, chunk #66]

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 的投資策略是持續擴充 AWS 基礎設施並大規模投資 AI，包括透過股權投資與融資安排支持 Anthropic、OpenAI 等 AI 公司，同時利用 AWS 雲端服務與晶片來強化其 AI 能力。[AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #97]  
Amazon 說明其技術與基礎設施成本包括研發人員薪資、伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷、租金、水電等，這些費用反映其在提供廣泛產品與服務方面的投資，尤其是支援 AWS 和其他業務的基礎設施。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
Amazon 強調其在技術與基礎設施上的投資旨在提升客戶體驗與提高流程效率，並預計隨著基礎設施與員工的增加，尤其是為支援人工智慧與機器學習 iniciativa，技術與基礎設施支出將隨時間增加。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
2025 年度，Amazon 指出技術與基礎設施成本增加主要來自基礎設施支出（包括折舊與攤銷），外匯匯率變動當年增加了 3.12 億美元（$312 million） 的成本。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]  
2026 年第二季及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六個月，技術與基礎設施成本增加主要來自基礎設施支出增加，外匯匯率對該季影響不大，但對六個月累計增加了 4.27 億美元（$427 million）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
Amazon 亦指出其技術與基礎設施成本在 Q2 2026 包含與能源合約相關的未實現淨收益，主要與 AWS 有關，這些收益不影響現金流但未來可能對成本產生重大影響。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  
在 AI 合作方面，Amazon 自 2026 年 3 月 31 日後投資了 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 在 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並修改了主要用於提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業安排，其中包含與 AWS 晶片表現相關的合約義務。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
Amazon 同時為 Anthropic 設置了一筆不超過 200 億美元（$20.0 billion） 的融資額度，該額度將在 Anthropic 發生流動性事件（如 IPO）後 30 個月到期，起初無法動用，隨著 Amazon 在修改後的商業安排中達成特定運算容量里程碑，額度將逐步開放供 Anthropic 按其自行決定提取。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
融資額度的提取形式可以是新發行的 Anthropic 可轉換票據，或在流動性事件後（受 Amazon 持股上限限制）以 Anthropic 普通股換取現金。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
Amazon 還擁有選擇權，可最多投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 參與 Anthropic 未來的股權融資，行使該選擇權將減少可用融資額度的相應金額。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
2026 年第二季，Amazon 再次投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 購買 Anthropic Series G 非投票優先股，並透過行使選擇權投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 購買 Anthropic Series H 非投票優先股，使融資額度從 200 億美元（$20.0 billion） 減少至 150 億美元（$15.0 billion）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]  
該期間，Amazon 記錄了 approximately 505 億美元（$50.5 billion）（Q2 2026）及 628 億美元（$62.8 billion）（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六個月）的非投票優先股價格向上調整，計入「其他收入（支出），淨額」，以反映 Anthropic 融資的可觀察價格變動。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]  
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日與 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Amazon 資產負債表上記錄的非投票優先股金額約為 148 億美元（$14.8 billion） 與 925 億美元（$92.5 billion）；可轉換票據的公允價值約為 458 億美元（$45.8 billion） 與 979 億美元（$97.9 billion），相關未實現綜合收益（損失）為 395 億美元（$39.5 billion） 與 920 億美元（$92.0 billion）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #39]

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨的主要反壟斷與監管風險包括：反競爭與消費者保護調查、資料隱私與資料保護法規審查、專利侵權訴訟（如 AWS Nitro System 與 Intel 處理器專利）、義大利稅務挑戰，以及可能導致高額罰款、合規成本增加、業務實務被迫改變、聲譽受損及成長受阻等後果。  

- 公司面臨多項公開調查，指控其營運侵犯競爭或消費者保護規則，具體涉及 Amazon 經營的線上商店（包括其履約網路與 Prime 服務）以及 AWS 提供的雲服務某些方面【AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80】。  
- 同時，公司正受到規範個人資料收集、使用與揭露日益複雜的法規審查，解釋仍在演變，導致對其隱私做法的不確定性增加【AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80】。  
- 監管機構與立法者越來越關注對被視為線上「門檻守衛者」的科技公司施加更多控制，透過適用現行法規與採納新法規，這將提升合規成本並限制業務運作【AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80】。  
- 不利的法規、法律、裁決或解釋可能導致公司產生巨額成本、面臨預期外的民事與刑事責任或罰款（包括巨額金錢罰款）、減少產品或服務的需求或供應、增加經營成本、被迫以對業務有重大不利方式改變業務做法、損害聲譽、阻礙成長，或對營運產生其他重大影響【AMZN_10K_2024.html, chunk #80】。  
- 除了競爭與消費者保護議題外，公司亦須應對涉及專利與其他智慧財產、稅務、勞動與僱傭（包括配送司機的界定）、資料使用與保護、資料安全、資料定位、網路安全、商業爭議以及第三方提供的商品／服務（含人工智慧技術與服務）等廣泛範圍的訴訟、調查與其他程序，且此類程序的數量與規模隨業務擴張而增加【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。  
- 截至 2026 年初，公司在義大利面臨數項稅務與其他挑戰，並仍有多項公開調查，指控其營運侵犯競爭相關或消費者保護規則，涵蓋 Amazon 經營的線上商店（包括履約網路與 Prime）以及 AWS 雲服務的某些方面【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】；相同敘述亦出現在後續季報中【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125】。  
- 美國私人原告、各州檢察長及聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）自 2020 年 3 月起已提起訴訟，指控存在價格固定、壟斷、試圖壟斷及消費者保護不當得利等行為，違反美國聯邦及州反壟斷法、州消費者保護法以及加拿大與英國的反壟斷法；這些訴訟尋求數十億美元的據稱損害、三倍損害、懲罰性損害、禁令、結構性救濟、民事罰款、律師費與成本，並涉及指控 Amazon 在線上超級商店、市場服務或中介服務市場擁有壟斷地位，以及透過定價政策、精選商品展賣方資料、廣告做法、Prime 結構及自家產品推廣等方式從事反競爭行為【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 此外，Xockets, Inc. 在 2025 年 6 月對 Amazon Web Services, Inc. 提出兩項訴訟，指控 AWS Nitro System 的某些版本侵害多項美國專利（專利號 11,080,209；10,649,924；11,082,350；10,223,297；9,378,161；9,436,640；10,212,092）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
- 另一項專利爭議來自德國的 R2 Semiconductor Inc.，於 2024 年 3 月對 Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL 提起訴訟，主張 AWS EC2 實例使用特定 Intel 處理器侵犯歐洲專利號 3,376,653 B1（「開關轉換器的過電壓保護」），並尋求禁令、未具體金額的損害賠償及其他救濟【AMZN_10Q_202406.html, chunk #41】。  
- 公司亦經常面臨涉及專利與其他智慧財產、稅務、勞動與僱傭、競爭與反壟斷、隱私與資料保護、消費者保護、商業爭議以及我們及第三方提供的商品／服務等方面的索賠、訴訟及其他程序，這些程序的結果具有固有不可預測性，可能對特定期間的營運結果與現金流產生重大影響【AMZN_10Q_202406.html, chunk #41】。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入搜尋功能（例如 AI Overviews、增強推理與視覺化互動體驗）[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128][GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]，以及將其應用於 Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、YouTube、Google Workspace、Google Ads 與 Google Cloud 等產品[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131][GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140][GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]，實現在搜尋與其他產品生態系中的整合。  

- Gemini 3 為目前最智慧的 AI 模型，具備增強的推理能力，可支援視覺化與互動式使用體驗，並已整合至搜尋與 Gemini App 中[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]（FY2025）。  
- 根據 FY2025 10-K 報告，旗下共有 15 款半億使用者產品（其中七款擁有兩億使用者）均已採用 Gemini 模型[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。  
- 根據 FY2024 10-K 報告，Android、Chrome、Gmail、Maps、Play Store、Search 與 YouTube 這七款兩億使用者產品皆在使用 Gemini[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131]。  
- 在搜尋方面，AI Overviews 讓使用者能提出複雜問題、將概念分解為易於理解的格式，或對影片提出口頭問題[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- NotebookLM 透過摘錄來源並提供相關引用，協助使用者理解複雜資訊[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- Gemini App 提供圖像生成、程式碼支援與應用程式整合等新功能，讓使用者得以協同作業[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- Gemini for Google Workspace 協助使用者在 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用中撰寫、整理、視覺化、加速工作流程並提升會議品質[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- Gemini 已被用來改進 YouTube 的推薦系統[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- 廣告主可在 Google Ads 使用更新後的圖像生成功能，製作高品質廣告素材[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #135]。  
- Google Cloud 提供 Gemini Enterprise 與 Gemini for Google Workspace 等解決方案，幫助組織運用 AI 優化基礎設施、開發平台與世界級模型，並附有搜尋與客戶參與套件的目的建置代理人[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140]。  
- Google Workspace 長期運用 AI 提升語法、效率與安全性（如 Smart Reply、Smart Compose、Gmail 的惡意程式及釣魚防護），現在透過 Gemini for Google Workspace 將 AI 驅動的代理人引入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者撰寫、整理、視覺化、加速工作流程並進行更豐富的會議[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #140]。  

以上說明均依據所提供的 10-K 報告內容，並註明對應的財政年度（FY2025 或 FY2024）。[All citations as above]

Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. That unconventional spirit has been a driving force throughout our history, inspiring us to tackle big problems and invest in moonshots. It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company. We continue this work under the leadership of Alphabet and Google CEO, Sundar Pichai. Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence. Access and Technology for Everyone

The Internet is one of the world’s most powerful equalizers; it propels ideas, people, and businesses large and small. Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998. Since then, we have evolved from a company that helps people find answers to a company that also helps people get things done. We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是把元宇宙（metaverse）打造成下一代社交技術與運算平台，並透過持續投資於 AI 模型、可穿戴裝置、VR/AR 硬體與基礎建設來實現這個目標【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  

在 AI 方面，Meta 正在開發並訓練其 AI 模型，並預計將繼續加大這些投資【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】；其 AI 投資支撐內容排名系統、發現引擎、廣告工具、新興生成式 AI 體驗以及提升產品開發效率的工具，例如可在旗下應用程式、Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡與網頁上使用的 Meta AI 助手【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  

在 Reality Labs 方面，公司將資源導向 VR、Horizon 與可穿戴裝置等新平台與技術【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】，並預計這是一項複雜、演變且長期的計畫，將涉及新興技術開發、基礎建設投資、隱私與安全工作以及與其他公司、開發者、合作夥伴的協作【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。然而，這些投資目前產生的收入有限，已顯著降低整體營運利潤——具體而言，2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資使整體營運利潤減少約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion），且預計 2026 年的虧損將維持類似水平【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。  

Meta 同時承認其在消費者硬體與 VR/AR 領域的經驗相對有限，可能使其他公司在競爭中佔優；此外，其硬體產品常需依賴第三方行動平台，而這些平台不一定提供與自家競爭產品同等的互通性【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。Reality Labs 的工作也可能分散資源與管理注意力，並受到美國及國際層面的隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容監管、醫療裝置、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護與電子商務等法規影響，可能導致產品開發延遲、成本增加或需要大量管理時間與關注【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  

總體來說，Meta 的長期策略是以元宇宙為核心，透過 AI 驅動的服務與沉浸式硬體（VR/AR、可穿戴裝置）持續投資，儘管目前面臨財務壓力與技術、市場及監管的不確定性，但公司預計這些投資將在未來數年內繼續維持類似的規模與方向。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 透過在其 Family of Apps（如 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger）向廣告主販售廣告位置來賺取廣告收入，而 Meta AI 則作為跨應用的智慧助理，協助內容排序、推薦、廣告工具與生成式 AI 體驗，同時幫助使用者學習、創作和連結。  

- Meta 表示「我們產生 substantially all of our revenue 來自於向行銷者販售我們旗下應用程式（Family of Apps）的廣告位置」[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
- 廣告可讓行銷者達到各種行銷目標，且可出現在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方應用程式與網站上[META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21]  
- 廣告的展示數量會依產品而異（例如影片與 Reels 的變現率目前與 Feed、Stories 不同），且 Meta 會依產品與變現策略調整廣告數量或頻率[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  
- 每則廣告的平均價格是總廣告收入除以已投放廣告數量，代表行銷者為每則廣告所支付的平均價格[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  
- 當 Meta 不是廣告交易的主要方時，廣告收入會以淨基礎確認[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  
- Meta AI 是一個可在旗下應用程式、獨立應用程式、AI 眼鏡以及網路上使用的助理[META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]（亦見[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]）  
- Meta AI 的 AI 投資協助驅動應用程式內容排名系統、發現引擎（推薦相關內容）、廣告主用來觸達客戶的工具、新一代生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率的工具[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]  
- Meta AI 旨在協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結，以充分利用每一刻[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]（亦見[META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]）

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是憑藉其 AI 能力、視覺感測、自行設計的推論晶片、FSD 電腦、透過 OTA 軟體更新持續改進、龐大的真實世界資料集以及 Cortex 訓練叢集，並將這些技術延伸至機器人（Optimus）和 Robotaxi 業務。  

- Tesla 使用 AI 開發現實世界的應用，例如自動駕駛解決方案與機器人【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- Tesla 利用視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體來訓練人工神經網路，並由其內部自行設計的推論晶片加速此過程【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- Tesla 將自動駕駛所學的 AI 應用於機器人，例如 Optimus 這種通用自動人形機器人【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨來自既有車廠和新進競爭者的激烈競爭，且預計競爭將持續加劇。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
根據其最新年報，特斯拉指出全球汽車市場今天已經高度競爭，並預期未來競爭只會更加激烈。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
特斯拉的不同車型在各自的傳統細分市場中面臨直接競爭，例如 Cybertruck 與其他皮卡車競爭，Model S 與 Model X 則主要與高級轎車和 SUV 競爭，而 Model 3 與 Model Y 則面對小型至中型轎車與緊湊型 SUV 的競爭，這些市場都被描述為極具競爭性。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
許多既有車廠以及新進公司已經進入或宣布計畫進入電動車及其他替代能源車市場，包括混合動力、插電式混合動力和純電動車。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73][TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43]  
競爭也不限於動力系統，特斯拉亦面臨在自駕技術與服務、以及其他車輛應用與軟體平台方面的競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #73]  
儘管電動車市場成長，但電動車仍僅佔整體車銷售的一小部分，這使得特斯拉的市場表現易受多種因素影響，例如消費者對車輛特性、品質、安全、表現與成本的感知、續航里程與充電設施的限制、油價波動、政府補貼與激勵措施，以及對公司未來可行性的擔憂。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #70]  
此外，特斯拉的電池供應鏈相對集中，僅有少數合格供應商，任何供應中斷或原材料（鋰、鎳、鈷等）價格波動若無法透過漲價轉嫁，都可能削弱其盈餘與競爭力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #55][TSLA_10K_2024.html, chunk #70]

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司整體策略中的重要增長支柱，利用其汽車技術提供整合的太陽能加儲能解決方案，並支援電網服務、AI 軟體以及清潔能源、運輸與自動機械人等長遠布局。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  

該業務涵蓋設計、製造、安裝、銷售及租賃太陽能發電與儲能產品，並為住宅、商業、工業客戶及公用事業提供相關服務，透過網站、門市、畫廊以及渠道合作夥伴進行銷售。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  

同時提供能源產品的維修與保固服務（包括延長服務計畫），並為住宅客戶提供各種融資方案。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  

核心產品包括鋰離子電池儲能系統（如 Powerwall 與 Megapack）以及太陽能發電產品（如太陽能板與 Solar Roof）。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  

能源儲能產品充分利用來自車輛的元件層級技術，採用模組化設計以優化製造產能。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

憑藉電力電子專長，電池系統能與電力互聯互通，提供快速的注入與吸收電力服務。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

公司開發了遠端控制與調度能源儲存系統的軟體。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

透過 AI 能力，每款特斯拉能源儲存產品皆可透過韌體更新進行增強，並由 Powerhub（分散式能源資源，含 Powerwall 虛擬電廠）與 Autobidder（Megapack 電池）等軟體平台最佳化。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

2025 年開始製造新型住宅改造太陽能板，並於 2026 年 1 月開始首批客戶交付；同時持續生產兼具美觀、耐用與發電效率的 Solar Roof。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

太陽能發電產品的效率受益於自行開發的太陽能逆變器，該逆變器融合了電力電子技術。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

太陽能板與 Solar Roof 均設計為可與 Powerwall 整合使用。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

為支援清潔能源、運輸及自動機械人業務，特斯拉正投資並開發必要的基礎設施，包括增加運算硬體以更好地利用車輛收集的海量場景資料，持續訓練與改進人工神經網路以達到真實世界表現。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

2025 年於得州超級工廠擴充 Cortex 訓練叢集，並宣布與 Samsung 合作於美國製造先進半導體，用於 AI 推理與訓練。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

正在建設 Cortex 2 以進一步提升 AI 訓練運算容量。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

預計 2026 年將在車輛、機械人、能源儲存與電池製造六條新產線上提升產能，同時充分利用現有工廠、充電站及服務中心的佈局來支撐未來成長。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]  

這些舉措顯示能源生成與儲能業務不僅是獨立的收入來源，更是特斯拉實現「清潔能源＋智慧運輸」整體願景的關鍵環節。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2；TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26]

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
蘋果在其 10-K 說明，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦和平板市場面臨來自競爭對手的激烈價格競爭、產品模仿以及低成本結構的壓力，並且僅佔全球這些產品市場的少數市場份額。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23][AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]

- 許多競爭對手主要透過激進定價和極低成本結構競爭，並模仿蘋果產品及侵犯其知識產權。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23]  
- 此外，蘋果面臨來自具備重要技術、行銷、分銷等資源且擁有大量客戶基礎的成熟硬體、軟體與服務供應商的嚴重競爭。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23][AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]  
- 有些競爭對手擁有更廣泛的產品線、更低價的產品以及更大的活躍裝置安裝基礎。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23][AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]  
- 競爭特別激烈，因為競爭對手積極降價並壓縮產品毛利率。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23][AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]  
- 某些競爭對手具備資源、經驗或成本結構，能以幾乎無利潤甚至虧損的方式提供產品與服務。[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #23][AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]  
- 蘋果自認在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板及可穿戴設備市場中僅佔少數市場份額。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]

The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, and corporate reputation. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company faces substantial competition in these markets from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, some of the Company’s competitors have broader product lines, lower-priced products and a larger installed base of active devices. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company’s services compete with business models that provide content to users for free and use illegitimate means to obtain third-party digital content and applications. The Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products, or collaborate to offer integrated solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer. Supply of Components

Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources. The Company also competes for various components with other participants in the markets for smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Therefore, many components used by the Company, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortage and significant commodity pricing fluctuations. The Company uses some custom components that are not commonly used by its competitors, and new products introduced by the Company often utilize custom components available from only one source. When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased. The continued availability of these components at acceptable prices, or at all, may be affected if suppliers decide to concentrate on the production of common components instead of components customized to meet the Company’s requirements. The Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components; however, there can be no guarantee that the Company will be able to extend or renew these agreements on similar terms, or at all. Research and Development

Because the industries in which the Company competes are characterized by rapid technological advances, the Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily upon its ability to ensure a continual and timely flow of competitive products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company continues to develop new technologies to enhance existing products and services, and to expand the range of its offerings through research and development (“R&D”), licensing of intellectual property and acquisition of third-party businesses and technology. Intellectual Property

The Company currently holds a broad collection of intellectual property rights relating to certain aspects of its hardware, accessories, software and services. This includes patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets and other forms of intellectual property rights in the U.S. and various foreign countries. Although the Company believes the ownership of such intellectual property rights is an important factor in differentiating its business and that its success does depend in part on such ownership, the Company relies primarily on the innovative skills, technical competence and marketing abilities of its personnel. The Company regularly files patent, design, copyright and trademark applications to protect innovations arising from its research, development, design and marketing, and is currently pursuing thousands of applications around the world. Over time, the Company has accumulated a large portfolio of issued and registered intellectual property rights around the world. No single intellectual property right is solely responsible for protecting the Company’s products and services. The Company believes the duration of its intellectual property rights is adequate relative to the expected lives of its products and services. In addition to Company-owned intellectual property, many of the Company’s products and services are designed to include intellectual property owned by third parties. records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 的第三方開發者生態系黏著度主要來自於 App Store 提供的高收入分成（開發者保留大部分收益、蘋果只抽取佣金）、提供開發工具與 API、以及透過法規遵從（如 DMA）和替代購買機制來提升開發者在蘋果平台上的收益預期與成本效益，使其相對於 Android、Windows 等平台更具吸引力。  

- Apple 的未來表現部分取決於第三方軟體開發者的支援，客戶購買硬體的決策也依賴於第三方應用程式的可用性[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 若第三方應用程式停止開發與維護，客戶可能選擇不購買 Apple 產品[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 第三方應用程式的可用性取決於開發者對「在 Apple 平台開發、維護與升級」相較於競爭平台（Android、Windows、PlayStation 等）的相對利益的感知與分析[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 這種感知會基於 Apple 的市場地位、預期可產生的收入、未來產品銷售成長以及開發成本等因素[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 由於 Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦和平板電腦市場的佔有率屬少數，開發者可能較少傾向為 Apple 開發，而較願將資源投入市場份額較大的競爭平台[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 當開發者將精力放在競爭平台時，Apple 裝置上的應用程式可用性與品質會受到影響[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- Apple 依賴持續取得具吸引力與創新的第三方軟體來維持其產品競爭力[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- Apple 的產品與作業系統面臨快速技術變化；若開發者無法或不願跟上這個節奏，他們的應用可能無法提供更好的使用體驗、可能運作錯誤，導致用戶不滿與需求下降[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- Apple 透過 App Store 分發第三方應用程式；對絕大多數應用，開發者保留其在 App Store 產生的全部收入，Apple 只從應用程式及應用內數位服務或商品的銷售中抽取佣金[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- Apple 會因應競爭、市場情勢及法律監管需求對 App Store 進行變更，並預期未來會因立法舉措（例如歐盟數位市場法案 DMA）而做出進一步調整，包括新的商業條款、替代費用結構、替代分配方式、替代付款處理以及提供額外的工具與 API[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 這些變更也可能影響 Apple 向開發者收取的平台使用費、App Store 外的應用分配方式，以及開發者在 App Store 內關於替代購買機制的溝通方式[AAPL_10K_2023.html, chunk #41]。  
- 此類變更若導致銷售量下降或佣金率縮小，將會影響 Apple 從開發者那裡獲得的收入[AAPL_10K_2023.html, chunk #41]。  
- Apple 已實施的變更包括：開發者與消費者在 App Store 外部就替代購買機制的溝通方式；以及在美國 iOS/iPadOS App Store 前台，開發者與消費者內部就替代購買機制的溝通方式[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  
- 為符合歐盟 DMA，Apple 亦對 iOS、iPadOS、App Store 與 Safari 進行了修改，提供新的商業條款、替代費用結構、替代分配方式、替代付款處理以及額外的工具與 API[AAPL_10K_2024.html, chunk #41]。  

以上說明展示了 Apple 如何透過收入分成、開發工具與 API、法規遵從（如 DMA）以及替代購買機制來提升開發者在其平台上的預期收益與降低成本，從而在與 Android、Windows 等平台的競爭中建立第三方開發者生態系的黏著度。所有事實均引用自提供的參考資料。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

•platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud

Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

•Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and

•other enterprise services. Our cloud services are generally provided on either a consumption or subscription basis and may have contract terms longer than a year.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] [section: Understanding Alphabet’s Financial Results] As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure. Continued Investment in Intellectual Property through R&D and Acquisitions: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, and improve our existing offerings across our businesses. We are subject to formal and informal inquiries and investigations as well as litigation on various competition matters by regulatory authorities and private parties in the US, Europe, and other jurisdictions globally, including the following:

•Shopping: In June 2017, the EC announced its decision that certain actions taken by Google relating to its display and ranking of shopping search results and ads infringed European antitrust laws and imposed a €2.4 billion fine. In 2024, we made a cash payment of $3.0 billion for the fine. •Android: In July 2018, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's Android-related distribution agreements infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €4.3 billion fine, and directed the termination of the conduct at issue. We appealed the EC decision and implemented changes to certain of our Android distribution practices. In September 2022, the General Court affirmed the EC decision but reduced the fine from €4.3 billion to €4.1 billion. We subsequently appealed the General Court's affirmation of the EC decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending. In 2018, we recognized a charge of $5.1 billion for the fine, which we reduced by $217 million in 2022. •AdSense for Search: In March 2019, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's agreements with AdSense for Search partners infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €1.5 billion fine, and directed actions related to AdSense for Search partners' agreements, which we implemented prior to the decision. In 2019, we recognized a charge of $1.7 billion for the fine and appealed the EC decision. In September 2024, the General Court overturned the EC decision and annulled the €1.5 billion fine. The EC has appealed the General Court's decision with the European Court of Justice. •Search: In October 2020, the DOJ and a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the District of Columbia concerning Google's Search and Search advertising practices and its compliance with US antitrust laws. In August 2024, the US District Court for the District of Columbia ruled against Google. A final judgment was entered in December 2025, which, among other things, imposes restrictions on how Google distributes its services and requires Google to share certain search data with and offer syndication services to certain competitors. In January 2026, we appealed the final judgment and moved to pause implementation of certain remedies. In February 2026, the DOJ and state Attorneys General also appealed. Further, in June 2022, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) opened an investigation into Search distribution practices. In August 2025, we agreed to a settlement with the ACCC requiring, among other things, changes to our Android agreements. We recognized a charge in the second quarter of 2025, and the settlement was approved by the court in December 2025. In October 2023, the Japanese Fair Trade Commission (JFTC) opened an investigation into Search distribution practices. In April 2025, the JFTC issued a cease-and-desist order requiring us to make changes to our Android agreements to ensure they are consistent with Japanese antitrust law. The JFTC did not impose monetary penalties. •Advertising Technology: In December 2020, a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas concerning Google's advertising technology and its compliance with US antitrust laws and state deceptive trade laws. In January 2023, the DOJ, along with a number of state Attorneys General, filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia concerning Google's advertising technology and its compliance with US antitrust laws, and a number of additional state Attorneys General subsequently joined the lawsuit. In April 2025, the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia issued a mixed decision in the DOJ case against Google, ruling that neither Google's advertiser tools nor the DoubleClick and AdMeld acquisitions were anticompetitive, but that Google's publisher tools unfairly excluded rivals. A separate proceeding to determine remedies, the range of which vary widely, took place in September 2025, with the parties presenting differing remedy proposals.

The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, and corporate reputation. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company faces substantial competition in these markets from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, some of the Company’s competitors have broader product lines, lower-priced products and a larger installed base of active devices. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company’s services compete with business models that provide content to users for free and use illegitimate means to obtain third-party digital content and applications. The Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products, or collaborate to offer integrated solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer. Supply of Components

Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources. The Company also competes for various components with other participants in the markets for smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Therefore, many components used by the Company, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortage and significant commodity pricing fluctuations. The Company uses some custom components that are not commonly used by its competitors, and new products introduced by the Company often utilize custom components available from only one source. When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased. The continued availability of these components at acceptable prices, or at all, may be affected if suppliers decide to concentrate on the production of common components instead of components customized to meet the Company’s requirements. The Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components; however, there can be no guarantee that the Company will be able to extend or renew these agreements on similar terms, or at all. Research and Development

Because the industries in which the Company competes are characterized by rapid technological advances, the Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily upon its ability to ensure a continual and timely flow of competitive products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company continues to develop new technologies to enhance existing products and services, and to expand the range of its offerings through research and development (“R&D”), licensing of intellectual property and acquisition of third-party businesses and technology. Intellectual Property

The Company currently holds a broad collection of intellectual property rights relating to certain aspects of its hardware, accessories, software and services. This includes patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets and other forms of intellectual property rights in the U.S. and various foreign countries. Although the Company believes the ownership of such intellectual property rights is an important factor in differentiating its business and that its success does depend in part on such ownership, the Company relies primarily on the innovative skills, technical competence and marketing abilities of its personnel. The Company regularly files patent, design, copyright and trademark applications to protect innovations arising from its research, development, design and marketing, and is currently pursuing thousands of applications around the world. Over time, the Company has accumulated a large portfolio of issued and registered intellectual property rights around the world. No single intellectual property right is solely responsible for protecting the Company’s products and services. The Company believes the duration of its intellectual property rights is adequate relative to the expected lives of its products and services. In addition to Company-owned intellectual property, many of the Company’s products and services are designed to include intellectual property owned by third parties. It may be necessary in the future to seek or renew licenses relating to various aspects of the Company’s products, processes and services. While the Company has generally been able to obtain such licenses on commercially reasonable terms in the past, there is no guarantee that such licenses could be obtained in the future on reasonable terms or at all.

Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

While these arrangements can lower operating costs, they also reduce the Company’s direct control over production and distribution.

Intelligent Cloud

Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

•Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses, and other on-premises offerings. •Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Nuance professional services, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience. More Personal Computing

Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology. This segment primarily comprises:

•Windows and Devices, including Windows OEM licensing (Windows Pro and non-Pro licenses sold through the OEM channel) and Devices, comprising Surface and PC accessories. •Gaming, including Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services, comprising first- and third-party content (including games and in-game content), Xbox Game Pass and other subscriptions, Xbox Cloud Gaming, advertising, and other cloud services. •Search advertising (formerly Search and news advertising), comprising Bing, Copilot, Microsoft News, Microsoft Edge, and third-party affiliates. records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 以約 295 億美元（$29.5 billion）收購 Wiz，這筆交易的財務結果被納入 Google Cloud 部門，並為該部門增加了大量無形資產與商譽，預期帶來多雲端與 AI 安全的協同效應。  

- 收購價格為 295 億美元（$29.5 billion）（扣除購買價格調整及後續合併補償安排後）[GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #50]，亦在後續說明中重複為 295 億美元（$29.5 billion）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67]。  
- 收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果被納入合併財務報表中的 **Google Cloud** 區段[GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #50][GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #126][GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #154][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #51]。  
- 初步購買價格分配（以百萬美元計）為：無形資產 8,300；商譽 22,705（或 22,689）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #51]; 假淨負債 1,538；總購買價格 29,467[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #51]。  
- 商譽已記錄在 **Google Cloud** 區段，主要歸因於預期在收購後產生的協同效應，且不適用於稅前扣除[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #51]。  

因此，此收購不僅提升了 Google Cloud 在多雲端與 AI 驅動安全領域的能力，亦透過龐大的無形資產與商譽增加，強化了該部門的長期競爭優勢。[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67][GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #50]

[NVDA 10-Q period 202504] [section: Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges] On April 9, 2025, the U.S. government, or USG, informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations as the demand for H20 products diminished. The $4.5 billion charge was less than what we initially anticipated as we were able to re-use certain materials. Sales of our H20 products were $4.6 billion for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 prior to the new export licensing requirements. The H20 export licensing requirements have impacted our current revenue and will also negatively affect our future revenue. We are still evaluating our limited options to supply Data Center compute products compliant with the USG’s export control rules. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. We may be unable to create a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from the USG. In that event, we would effectively be foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, with a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition. 22

We believe the China AI market to be a significant opportunity and the existing and new export controls will greatly hinder our ability to address this opportunity and will continue to impact our revenue and operational results. We continue to execute Data Center compute product introductions, bringing new advanced architectures on a one-year product cadence. We expect to begin shipping samples and production units of our new Blackwell Ultra platforms in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Our product transitions and sophisticated system configurations may create challenges in managing supply and demand.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的 GPU 與 CUDA 平台形成了深度整合的硬體‑軟體生態系統，這使得它成為 AI 運算的首選基礎設施，難以被競爭者快速複製。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

- NVIDIA 是開創加速運算的先驅，現在提供資料中心規模的 AI 基礎設施，重塑各產業。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19][NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #120]  
- 其技術堆疊包含可在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行的基礎 CUDA 開發平台，以及數百個特定領域的軟體庫、SDK、API，這些軟體堆疊能加速並簡化 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算等計算密集型工作負載。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19][NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #120]  
- NVIDIA 採取平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、庫、AI 模型、訓練資料集與服務結合，為所服務的市場創造獨特價值。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]  
- 透過統一的可編程架構，NVIDIA 能以相同的底層技術支援多個數十億美元規模的終端市場，並藉由內部或第三方開發者提供的各種軟體堆疊來實現。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]  
- 平台上開發者與已安裝基礎的數量持續增長，進一步強化生態系統並提升平台對客戶的價值。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]  
- 自成立以來，NVIDIA 在研發上的投資超過 767 億美元（$76.7 billion）（2026 年 10‑K）以及超過 582 億美元（$58.2 billion）（2025 年 10‑K），這些投資孕育了 GPU 的發明（1999 年）、CUDA 程式設計模型（2006 年）以及首款 Tensor Core GPU（2017 年）等關鍵創新。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]  
- Blackwell 架構進一步實現晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法的極端共同設計，使得數十萬顆 GPU 能互連成單一巨型電腦，滿足現代 AI 訓練與推論的規模需求。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  
- GPU 擁有數萬個運算核心的平行處理能力，是深度學習演算法的基礎，這使得它在 AI 運算中不可替代。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19][NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #120]  

以上因素——整合的硬體‑軟體平台、廣泛的開發者生態系統、持續的高額研發投入以及不斷演進的架構——共同構成了競爭者難以快速複製的壁壘，因而許多 AI 應用依賴 NVIDIA 的技術。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2025.html, chunk #19]

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過將 Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 AI 功能直接整合到 Office 產品線中，把 AI 工具塞進 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等軟體裡。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35]  
Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為一個 AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台，它將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在一起，以協助組織賦能員工。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35]  
該平台的成長依賴於在通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規以及其他 AI 商業生產力類別中，為核心產品與服務加入 AI 啟用的工具、功能與 agenteic（代理）場景。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35]  
具體來看，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入因 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶來的每用戶收入增長而上升 19%。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]  
同時，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的座位數因中小企業與前線工作者供應而成長 6%，而傳統授權產品收入則微增 1%。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]  
為支撐這些 AI 功能，微軟在成本端增加了投資於 AI 基礎設施，以支撐 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的座位與使用量成長。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #128]  
在營運費用方面，微軟持續加大在研發運算容量、AI 人才與數據上的投資，以支援整個產品組合的開發，並增加 Copilot 的廣告與商業銷售支出。[MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #128]  
此外，Microsoft 365 Consumer 雲端收入也因每用戶收入增長與訂戶數增加 7%而實現 33% 的增長，顯示 AI 功能亦被納入消費者版 Office 供應中。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]  
這些投資與整合使得 AI 功能得以直接嵌入 Office 軟體中，提升使用者的生產力與創造力。[MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68]（此處為概括性說明，基於前述多項數據與敘述）

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Our reportable segments are described below. Productivity and Business Processes

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Microsoft 365 Commercial Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. Competition

Competitors to Office include software and global application vendors, web-based and mobile application companies, AI-first application companies, as well as local application developers.

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在 AI 領域大舉投資 OpenAI，已於 2026 年第一季投資 150億美元並簽署 AWS 雲端服務合作與聯合開發協議，並在第二季再追加 137億美元，累計已投資 287億美元，並承諾最多可達 350億美元。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #73]  
具體來說，亞馬遜與 OpenAI 在 2026 年第一季達成兩項協議：(i) 提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業安排，包含使用與效能測試 AWS 晶片；(ii) 聯合合作協議，讓 OpenAI 模型的某些服務在亞馬遜及 AWS 上提供。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
亞馬遜亦於該季投資 150億美元購買 OpenAI 的 C 系列優先股，並簽署股權承諾函（Letter Agreement），同意再購買額外的 C 系列優先股，總承諾金額為 350億美元。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
隨後在 2026 年第二季，亞馬遜已將該承諾金額中的 137億美元投資於同一系列優先股。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，亞馬遜在合併資產負債表上列示的 OpenAI C 系列優先股投資金額為 287億美元，剩餘的 213億美元承諾金額將於之後續投資。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
此外，亞馬遜持有的非權益法私人公司股權（主要為 Anthropic 的非投票優先股及 OpenAI 的優先股）在 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2026 年 6 月 30 日的賬面價值分別為 162億美元及 1,223億美元。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
因此，亞馬遜最近的 AI 投資主要針對 OpenAI，並透過 AWS 雲端服務與聯合開發深化合作關係。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40; AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #73]

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
是的，Google 的 AI 助手 Gemini 已經整合進搜尋引擎，透過 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 為使用者提供直接回答與更複雜的查詢功能。[GOOGL_10K_2024.html, chunk #131] 指出「Gemini is powering AI features across our products and services… all seven of our two‑billion‑user products — Android, Chrome, Gmail, Maps, Play Store, Search, and YouTube — are using Gemini」，表示 Search 已經使用 Gemini。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196] 進一步說明「we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search」，證實 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 已被納入 Search。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132] 補充說「AI Overviews makes it easier to ask Google anything and get a helpful response. AI Mode allows users to ask more nuanced questions … using Gemini’s advanced reasoning, thinking, and multimodal capabilities」，說明這些 AI 功能正是以 Gemini 為基礎，直接為搜尋提供助理般的體驗。因此，Google 的 AI 助手已經整合進搜尋引擎。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正透過其 VR 眼鏡（如 Meta Quest）與 AI 眼鏡（如 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）以及未來的擴增實境（AR）裝置（如 Orion 原型、Meta Ray‑Ban Display）結合其 AI 助理 Meta AI，打造一個讓人隨時隨地感受連結的沉浸式生態系統，並將其視為下一代運算平台與未來社交互動的核心。  

Meta 的使命是建構人類連結的未來及其技術，旨在讓人們透過行動裝置、個人電腦、VR 耳機與 AI 眼鏡連結與分享【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
Meta 正在 AI 技術上進行創新，以打造跨越其應用程式家族與新平台的轉型體驗，並推進其願景——為每個人提供個人化超智能（superintelligence）【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
該公司致力於開發協助人們連結、分享、尋找與建立社群以及成長企業的技術【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
Meta 也幫助人們發現與了解世界、分享經驗、隨時隨地保持連線【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
為建構下一代運算平台，Meta 正將其產品從 2D 螢幕延伸至沉浸式的擴增實境與虛擬實境體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
Meta 的願景不聚焦於單一產品，而是構建由體驗、裝置與新技術組成的整個生態系統，並以 AI 為驅動力【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
雖然元宇宙仍處於早期階段，Meta 相信它將成為下一代運算平台與未來社交互動的形式【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
Meta 透過打造讓平台更具社交性、實用性與沉浸感的新體驗來持續創新【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
Meta 的 AI 投資支援其產品與服務中的多項計畫，包括內容排名系統、發現引擎、廣告商工具、生成式 AI 體驗開發以及提升產品開發效率的工具【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
公司同時致力於開發下一代 AI 模型，並推進其構建超智能的願景——即超越人類智慧的 AI【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
雖然預測超智能何時實現具有挑戰性，Meta 仍在投資，因為相信這將開啟個人 empowerment 的新時代【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

Meta 的產品亦可透過行動裝置、個人電腦、VR/MR 耳機、AR 與可穿戴裝置讓人們連結與分享【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
該公司同樣協助人們發現與了解世界、分享經驗、隨時保持連線【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
為建構下一代運算平台，Meta 正將產品從 2D 螢幕延伸至增強實境、混合實境與虛擬實境的沉浸式體驗【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
Meta 的願景同樣不聚焦於單一產品，而是構建體驗、裝置與新技術的整個生態系統【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
雖然元宇宙仍處於早期階段，Meta 相信它將成為下一代運算平台與未來社交互動的形式【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
Meta 透過 AI 技術創新，打造讓平台更具社交性、實用性與沉浸感的新體驗【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
Meta 的 AI 投資支援內容排名、發現引擎、廣告商工具、生成式 AI 體驗開發以及提升產品開發效率的工具【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
例如，Meta AI 助理可在其應用程式、Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡以及網頁上使用，旨在協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
Meta 財務報告分為兩個主要部門：Family of Apps（FoA）與 Reality Labs（RL）【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
大部分收入來自於在 Family of Apps 上向廣告商銷售廣告位，這反映在 FoA 部門【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  
Reality Labs 部門則透過銷售消費者硬體產品、軟體與內容來產生收入【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #21】。  

Meta 開發的產品讓人們能透過行動裝置、個人電腦、VR 耳機與 AI 眼鏡在美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞太及國際市場連結與分享【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
公司透過兩個部門營運：Family of Apps（FoA）與 Reality Labs（RL）【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
FoA 包含 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Meta AI、Threads 與 WhatsApp【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
RL 提供虛擬與擴增實境產品，包括消費者硬體、軟體與內容，協助人們感受連結，並提供 Meta Quest 裝置以支援遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
RL 部門亦包括可穿戴裝置，如 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta AI 眼鏡；以及 Meta Ray‑Ban Display（結合 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建顯示器）和 Meta Neural Band（使用肌電圖讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡的腕帶裝置）【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

在近期，Meta 繼續開發讓人們隨時隨地感受連結的產品與體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
目前的 VR 產品線包括 Meta Quest 裝置，以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，讓使用者能突破物理距離，參與遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
為提升 VR 的接受度與採用率，Meta 引入了 passthrough 功能，讓使用者在仍能感知實體世界的同時體驗 VR 的沉浸與存在感【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
可穿戴裝置的工作重點在 AI 眼鏡與長期的 AR 計畫【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
目前的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，內建 Meta AI（先進的對話式助理）以及免手操作等功能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
為推進 AR 眼鏡的市場化，Meta 在 2024 年發表了 Orion 原型——一副真正的 AR 眼鏡，能將內容疊加在實體世界上，具備業界領先的視野與舒適的眼鏡形態【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
2025 年，Meta 推出 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建的顯示器結合，並配備 Meta Neural Band——一個使用肌電圖讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡的腕帶可穿戴裝置【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
總體來說，Reality Labs 的工作包括短期的產品上市開發專案，以及長期的研究與開發項目【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

Reality Labs 的許多投資導向長期、前沿的研發，針對尚未上市且可能需十年才能完全實現的產品；這包括探索利用肌電圖的神經介面（讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制裝置），以及在 AI 與硬體上的創新，以構建下一代介面【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
在近期，Meta 繼續開發早期的元宇宙與可穿戴產品與體驗，讓人們隨時隨地感受連結【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
元宇宙的工作涵蓋 VR、MR 與社交平台的計畫【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
目前的 VR 產品線包括 Meta Quest 裝置以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，讓使用者能突破物理距離，參與遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
為提升 VR 的接受度與採用率，Meta 引入了 MR 功能，讓使用者在仍能感知實體世界的同時體驗 VR 的沉浸與存在感【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
可穿戴裝置的工作重點在 AR 計畫；Meta 持續推進路線圖，以加入更多 AI 支援的供應，例如 Ray‑Ban Meta AI 眼鏡（內建 Meta AI 以及免手操作功能）【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
為推進 AR 眼鏡的市場化，Meta 在 2024 年亦發表了 Orion 原型——一副真正的 AR 眼鏡，能將內容疊加在實體世界上，具備業界領先的視野與舒適的眼鏡形態【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
雖然所有投資都是長期打造下一代運算平台的一部分，但元宇宙工作也包含許多較短期的產品上市開發專案；相對地，可穿戴工作則主要導向長期的研究與開發【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
例如，預計在 2025 年，Reality Labs 的營運費用將有約 50% 用於可穿戴裝置計畫，剩餘 50% 用於元宇宙計畫【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
此費用分配的估算需要重大判斷，因為各產品線間存在共享成本，且預期會隨著下一代運算平台的發展與業務策略的演變而變動【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。  
Meta 會定期檢視產品路線圖，並根據對技術挑戰、市場格局以及產品構想與設計的理解，進行重大調整【META_10K_2024.html, chunk #24】。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. Our products enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) and mixed reality (MR) headsets, augmented reality (AR), and wearables. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented, mixed, and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. For example, Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, on Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment. We report financial results for two segments: Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers, which is reflected in FoA. Ads on our platform enable marketers to reach people across a range of marketing objectives, such as generating leads or driving awareness. Marketers purchase ads that can appear in multiple places including on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party applications and websites. RL generates revenue from sales of consumer hardware products, software, and content.

--- Business Summary --- Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction.
